stem:
Hemant has a fixed wall to paint. He asks how the number of days changes when the number of identical workers doubles.

Which claim is correct before finding the new number of days?

options.text: Call the situation direct proportion, because the word double appears.
Treat days and workers as rising together, even though the wall size is fixed.
Treat days and workers as inverse proportion: more workers mean fewer days for the same wall.
Workers produce the wall size, so reverse and ignore how days change.

teacher.key_rationale: Fixed work with more workers means fewer days, so the relation is inverse before any calculation. Labelling it direct from the word double swaps the proportion type. Assuming both rise together drops the fixed-wall condition. Reversing so workers produce wall size flips the decision hinge.
